notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 timestamped Send Interaction and timestamped Receive Interaction C++ surfaces to the official declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. It covers the non-regional logical-time overload, federation-owned queueing for constrained recipients, callback-before-grant ordering, official timestamp/order/retraction fields, and the default-source/default-region FQR/TARA/NMRA companion with supplied-empty region metadata. A focused untimed save/restore companion also reconstructs one queued default-source interaction, preserves its supplied-empty callback projection and live retraction designator, and proves Flush Queue delivery plus Request Retraction. Regulation-role companions keep accepted queued TSO interactions through Disable Time Regulation and callback-gated re-enable at unchanged lookahead, including the default-source/default-region regional callback path, then prove exactly one callback before the survivor's grant. Voluntary-source-resignation companions now keep accepted TSO interaction state in one survivor and in two recipient-local queues, with the independent regulator releasing direct TAR/NMR boundaries after the producer leaves. Regional Send Interaction With Regions, directed interaction, deletion, broader alternate advances, remote transport, durable/general timed save/restore, package/JUnit/protected-review evidence, and conformance remain separate scope.
